svg.title: Test scope trades feedback speed against integrated confidence
svg.desc: A single browser journey can establish that several pieces work together, but a failure may have many possible causes. Focused tests isolate business rules and provide quicker, more precise feedback. Integration tests cover assumptions that mocks cannot establish, such as real query behavior. The pyramid encourages a useful feedback structure, not a fixed percentage quota or a promise about every test's runtime.
svg.text: Test scope trades feedback speed against integrated confidence
The widening base suggests more focused checks; it does not prescribe numerical quotas.
Real interactions such as a service and its database.
Focused behavior with narrow dependencies and fast feedback.
A passing narrow test and a passing integrated journey provide different evidence.
